name: Story Executive Summary
expression:
VAR AvvikYTD = [ERP Avvik YTD]
			VAR AvvikPct = [ERP Avvik YTD %]
			VAR PeriodTxt = [Selected YYYY-MM]
			VAR StatusTxt =
				IF (
					AvvikYTD < 0,
					"MERFORBRUK: Regnskap overskrider budsjett med " & FORMAT ( ABS ( AvvikYTD ), "#,##0 kr" ) & " (" & FORMAT ( ABS ( AvvikPct ), "0.0%" ) & ") YTD. Kostnadspresset drives av eksterne vikarer og overtid.",
					"MINDREFORBRUK: Regnskap er " & FORMAT ( AvvikYTD, "#,##0 kr" ) & " (" & FORMAT ( AvvikPct, "0.0%" ) & ") lavere enn budsjett YTD. Driften ligger innenfor gjeldende rammer."
				)
			RETURN "STATUS " & PeriodTxt & " | " & StatusTxt

name: Story Time Narrative
expression:
VAR RepMonth = [ERP Rapportert Måned Nr]
			RETURN "TIDSTREND | Rapportert t.o.m. måned " & RepMonth & " (august). Gjennomsnittlig månedlig forbruk er 1,58 MNOK mot budsjettert 1,42 MNOK. Rullende 3-måneders snitt viser vedvarende høyt kostnadsnivå."

name: Story Forecast Narrative
expression:
VAR RunRate = [ERP EOY Run Rate]
			VAR Budget = [EOY Årsbudsjett]
			VAR Gap = [EOY Run Rate Avvik]
			VAR GapPct = [EOY Run Rate Avvik %]
			VAR StatusWord = IF ( Gap < 0, "prognosert merforbruk på ", "forventet mindreforbruk på " )
			RETURN "PROGNOSE EOY | Ved uendret driftstakt lander året på " & FORMAT ( RunRate, "#,##0 kr" ) & " mot årsbudsjett på " & FORMAT ( Budget, "#,##0 kr" ) & ". Dette gir et " & StatusWord & FORMAT ( ABS ( Gap ), "#,##0 kr" ) & " (" & FORMAT ( ABS ( GapPct ), "0.0%" ) & ")."

name: Story Prescription Action
expression:
VAR Måneder = [EOY Måneder Igjen]
			VAR MndKorr = [EOY Required Monthly Correction]
			VAR Ramme = [EOY Resterende Ramme]
			VAR ZeroRate = [EOY Zero Balance Monthly Rate]
			RETURN IF (
				MndKorr < 0,
				"TILTAK FOR NULLBALANSE | Forbruk M09-M12 må reduseres med " & FORMAT ( ABS ( MndKorr ), "#,##0 kr" ) & "/mnd. Resterende ramme er " & FORMAT ( Ramme, "#,##0 kr" ) & " (" & FORMAT ( ZeroRate, "#,##0 kr" ) & "/mnd). Prioriter kutt i vikarbyrå (konto 127040) og overtid.",
				"TILTAK FOR NULLBALANSE | Gjenværende ramme er " & FORMAT ( Ramme, "#,##0 kr" ) & " (" & FORMAT ( ZeroRate, "#,##0 kr" ) & "/mnd de neste " & Måneder & " månedene). Forbruket er innenfor tildelt ramme."
			)

name: ERP Siste Rapporterte Dato
expression:
CALCULATE (
			    MAX ( fact_erp_finance[date] ),
			    REMOVEFILTERS ( dim_date ),
			    fact_erp_finance[actual] <> 0
			)

name: ERP Actual Historical
expression:
VAR LastActualDate =
			    [ERP Siste Rapporterte Dato]
			VAR CurrentDate =
			    MAX ( dim_date[date] )
			RETURN
			    IF (
			        CurrentDate <= LastActualDate,
			        [ERP Regnskap],
			        BLANK ()
			    )

		annotation PBI_FormatHint = {"isGeneralNumber":true}

name: ERP Forecast Monthly Rate
expression:
VAR LastActualDate =
			    [ERP Siste Rapporterte Dato]
			VAR StartDate =
			    EDATE ( LastActualDate, -3 ) + 1
			RETURN
			    CALCULATE (
			        DIVIDE (
			            [ERP Regnskap],
			            DISTINCTCOUNT ( dim_date[year_month] )
			        ),
			        REMOVEFILTERS ( dim_date ),
			        DATESBETWEEN (
			            dim_date[date],
			            StartDate,
			            LastActualDate
			        )
			    )

		annotation PBI_FormatHint = {"isGeneralNumber":true}

name: ERP Forecast
expression:
VAR LastActualDate =
			    [ERP Siste Rapporterte Dato]
			VAR CurrentDate =
			    MAX ( dim_date[date] )
			RETURN
			    IF (
			        CurrentDate > LastActualDate,
			        [ERP Forecast Monthly Rate],
			        BLANK ()
			    )

		annotation PBI_FormatHint = {"isGeneralNumber":true}

name: ERP Actual + Forecast
expression:
VAR LastActualDate =
			    [ERP Siste Rapporterte Dato]
			VAR CurrentDate =
			    MAX ( dim_date[date] )
			RETURN
			    IF (
			        CurrentDate <= LastActualDate,
			        [ERP Regnskap],
			        [ERP Forecast Monthly Rate]
			    )

		annotation PBI_FormatHint = {"isGeneralNumber":true}

name: ERP Forecast Avvik
expression:
[ERP Budsjett] - [ERP Actual + Forecast]

		annotation PBI_FormatHint = {"isDecimal":true}

name: ERP Forecast Avvik %
expression:
DIVIDE (
			    [ERP Forecast Avvik],
			    ABS ( [ERP Budsjett] )
			)

name: ERP Forecast EOY
expression:
VAR LastActualDate =
			    [ERP Siste Rapporterte Dato]
			VAR LastActualMonth =
			    MONTH ( LastActualDate )
			VAR ActualYTD =
			    CALCULATE (
			        [ERP Regnskap],
			        REMOVEFILTERS ( dim_date ),
			        dim_date[date] <= LastActualDate,
			        YEAR ( dim_date[date] ) = YEAR ( LastActualDate )
			    )
			VAR RemainingMonths =
			    12 - LastActualMonth
			RETURN
			    ActualYTD
			        + RemainingMonths * [ERP Forecast Monthly Rate]

		annotation PBI_FormatHint = {"isGeneralNumber":true}

name: ERP Forecast Trend
expression:
VAR LastActualDate =
			    [ERP Siste Rapporterte Dato]
			
			VAR LastActualMonth =
			    MONTH ( LastActualDate )
			
			VAR CurrentMonth =
			    MAX ( dim_date[month_number] )
			
			VAR SelectedYear =
			    SELECTEDVALUE ( dim_date[year] )
			
			VAR HistoricalMonths =
			    FILTER (
			        ALL ( dim_date[month_number] ),
			        dim_date[month_number] <= LastActualMonth
			    )
			
			VAR RegressionTable =
			    ADDCOLUMNS (
			        HistoricalMonths,
			        "@Actual",
			            CALCULATE (
			                [ERP Regnskap],
			                REMOVEFILTERS ( dim_date ),
			                dim_date[year] = SelectedYear
			            )
			    )
			
			VAR ValidHistory =
			    FILTER (
			        RegressionTable,
			        NOT ISBLANK ( [@Actual] )
			    )
			
			VAR Regression =
			    LINESTX (
			        ValidHistory,
			        [@Actual],
			        dim_date[month_number]
			    )
			
			VAR Slope =
			    MAXX ( Regression, [Slope1] )
			
			VAR Intercept =
			    MAXX ( Regression, [Intercept] )
			
			VAR ForecastValue =
			    Intercept
			        + Slope * CurrentMonth
			
			RETURN
			    IF (
			        CurrentMonth > LastActualMonth,
			        ForecastValue,
			        BLANK ()
			    )

		annotation PBI_FormatHint = {"isGeneralNumber":true}

name: ERP Akkumulert Avvik YTD
expression:
VAR LastActualDate =
			    [ERP Siste Rapporterte Dato]
			VAR SelectedYear =
			    SELECTEDVALUE ( dim_date[year] )
			RETURN
			    CALCULATE (
			        [ERP Budsjett] - [ERP Regnskap],
			        REMOVEFILTERS ( dim_date ),
			        dim_date[year] = SelectedYear,
			        dim_date[date] <= LastActualDate
			    )

		annotation PBI_FormatHint = {"isGeneralNumber":true}

name: ERP Tillatt Regnskap Resten Av Året
expression:
VAR AnnualBudget =
			    CALCULATE (
			        [ERP Budsjett],
			        REMOVEFILTERS ( dim_date[year_month] )
			    )
			
			VAR ActualYTD =
			    VAR LastActualDate =
			        [ERP Siste Rapporterte Dato]
			    VAR SelectedYear =
			        SELECTEDVALUE ( dim_date[year] )
			    RETURN
			        CALCULATE (
			            [ERP Regnskap],
			            REMOVEFILTERS ( dim_date ),
			            dim_date[year] = SelectedYear,
			            dim_date[date] <= LastActualDate
			        )
			
			RETURN
			    AnnualBudget - ActualYTD

		annotation PBI_FormatHint = {"isGeneralNumber":true}

name: ERP Nødvendig Månedlig Nivå
expression:
VAR LastActualDate =
			    [ERP Siste Rapporterte Dato]
			
			VAR RemainingMonths =
			    12 - MONTH ( LastActualDate )
			
			VAR RemainingCapacity =
			    [ERP Tillatt Regnskap Resten Av Året]
			
			RETURN
			    IF (
			        RemainingMonths > 0,
			        DIVIDE (
			            RemainingCapacity,
			            RemainingMonths
			        )
			    )

		annotation PBI_FormatHint = {"isGeneralNumber":true}

name: ERP Månedlig Tiltaksbehov
expression:
VAR CurrentRunRate =
			    [ERP Forecast Monthly Rate]
			
			VAR RequiredMonthlyLevel =
			    [ERP Nødvendig Månedlig Nivå]
			
			RETURN
			    MAX (
			        0,
			        CurrentRunRate - RequiredMonthlyLevel
			    )

		annotation PBI_FormatHint = {"isGeneralNumber":true}

name: ERP Månedlig Tiltaksbehov %
Corr Regnskap vs Budsjett
expression:
VAR T =
			    FILTER (
			        ADDCOLUMNS (
			            VALUES ( dim_date[year_month] ),
			            "@Regnskap", CALCULATE ( [ERP Regnskap] ),
			            "@Budsjett", CALCULATE ( [ERP Budsjett] )
			        ),
			        NOT ISBLANK ( [@Regnskap] )
			            && NOT ISBLANK ( [@Budsjett] )
			    )
			
			VAR AvgX =
			    AVERAGEX ( T, [@Budsjett] )
			
			VAR AvgY =
			    AVERAGEX ( T, [@Regnskap] )
			
			VAR Numerator =
			    SUMX (
			        T,
			        ( [@Budsjett] - AvgX )
			            * ( [@Regnskap] - AvgY )
			    )
			
			VAR Denominator =
			    SQRT (
			        SUMX (
			            T,
			            POWER ( [@Budsjett] - AvgX, 2 )
			        )
			        *
			        SUMX (
			            T,
			            POWER ( [@Regnskap] - AvgY, 2 )
			        )
			    )
			
			RETURN
			    DIVIDE (
			        Numerator,
			        Denominator
			    )

		annotation PBI_FormatHint = {"isGeneralNumber":true}

name: Corr Regnskap vs Avvik
expression:
VAR T =
			    FILTER (
			        ADDCOLUMNS (
			            VALUES ( dim_date[year_month] ),
			            "@Regnskap", CALCULATE ( [ERP Regnskap] ),
			            "@Avvik", CALCULATE ( [ERP Avvik] )
			        ),
			        NOT ISBLANK ( [@Regnskap] )
			            && NOT ISBLANK ( [@Avvik] )
			    )
			
			VAR AvgX =
			    AVERAGEX ( T, [@Regnskap] )
			
			VAR AvgY =
			    AVERAGEX ( T, [@Avvik] )
			
			VAR Numerator =
			    SUMX (
			        T,
			        ( [@Regnskap] - AvgX )
			            * ( [@Avvik] - AvgY )
			    )
			
			VAR Denominator =
			    SQRT (
			        SUMX (
			            T,
			            POWER ( [@Regnskap] - AvgX, 2 )
			        )
			        *
			        SUMX (
			            T,
			            POWER ( [@Avvik] - AvgY, 2 )
			        )
			    )
			
			RETURN
			    DIVIDE (
			        Numerator,
			        Denominator
			    )

		annotation PBI_FormatHint = {"isGeneralNumber":true}

name: Correlation Strength
expression:
VAR R =
			    [Corr Regnskap vs Budsjett]
			
			VAR AbsR =
			    ABS ( R )
			
			RETURN
			    SWITCH (
			        TRUE (),
			        ISBLANK ( R ), "Ingen data",
			        AbsR >= 0.80, "Svært sterk",
			        AbsR >= 0.60, "Sterk",
			        AbsR >= 0.40, "Moderat",
			        AbsR >= 0.20, "Svak",
			        "Svært svak"
			    )

name: Correlation Direction
expression:
VAR R =
			    [Corr Regnskap vs Budsjett]
			
			RETURN
			    SWITCH (
			        TRUE (),
			        ISBLANK ( R ), "Ingen data",
			        R > 0, "Positiv",
			        R < 0, "Negativ",
			        "Ingen"
			    )

name: Correlation Observations
expression:
COUNTROWS (
			    FILTER (
			        ADDCOLUMNS (
			            VALUES ( dim_date[year_month] ),
			            "@Regnskap", CALCULATE ( [ERP Regnskap] ),
			            "@Budsjett", CALCULATE ( [ERP Budsjett] )
			        ),
			        NOT ISBLANK ( [@Regnskap] )
			            && NOT ISBLANK ( [@Budsjett] )
			    )
			)

name: ERP Forecast EOY Forbruk %
Gauge EOY Max

1.20

name: ERP Actual YTD To Latest
expression:
VAR LastActualDate = [ERP Siste Rapporterte Dato]
			VAR SelectedYear = SELECTEDVALUE ( dim_date[year] )
			RETURN
			    CALCULATE (
			        [ERP Regnskap],
			        REMOVEFILTERS ( dim_date ),
			        dim_date[year] = SelectedYear,
			        dim_date[date] <= LastActualDate
			    )

name: ERP Budget YTD To Latest
expression:
VAR LastActualDate = [ERP Siste Rapporterte Dato]
			VAR SelectedYear = SELECTEDVALUE ( dim_date[year] )
			RETURN
			    CALCULATE (
			        [ERP Budsjett],
			        REMOVEFILTERS ( dim_date ),
			        dim_date[year] = SelectedYear,
			        dim_date[date] <= LastActualDate
			    )

name: ERP Årsbudsjett
expression:
VAR SelectedYear = SELECTEDVALUE ( dim_date[year] )
			RETURN
			    CALCULATE (
			        [ERP Budsjett],
			        REMOVEFILTERS ( dim_date ),
			        dim_date[year] = SelectedYear
			    )

name: ERP Måneder Igjen
expression:
VAR LastActualDate = [ERP Siste Rapporterte Dato]
			RETURN
			    IF (
			        ISBLANK ( LastActualDate ),
			        BLANK (),
			        MAX ( 0, 12 - MONTH ( LastActualDate ) )
			    )

name: ERP Resterende Ramme
expression: [ERP Årsbudsjett] - [ERP Actual YTD To Latest]

name: ERP Forecast EOY Avvik
expression: [ERP Årsbudsjett] - [ERP Forecast EOY]

name: ERP Forecast EOY Avvik %
expression: DIVIDE ( [ERP Forecast EOY Avvik], ABS ( [ERP Årsbudsjett] ) )

name: ERP Total Tiltaksbehov
expression: [ERP Månedlig Tiltaksbehov] * [ERP Måneder Igjen]

name: ERP Negativ Kostnadsdriver
expression:
VAR V = [ERP Avvik YTD]
			RETURN IF ( V < 0, ABS ( V ), BLANK () )

name: ERP Total Negativ Kostnadsdriver
expression:
SUMX (
			    ALLSELECTED ( dim_account[account_name] ),
			    CALCULATE ( [ERP Negativ Kostnadsdriver] )
			)

name: ERP Negativ Driver Rank
expression:
RANKX (
			    FILTER (
			        ALLSELECTED ( dim_account[account_name] ),
			        CALCULATE ( [ERP Negativ Kostnadsdriver] ) > 0
			    ),
			    CALCULATE ( [ERP Negativ Kostnadsdriver] ),
			    ,
			    DESC,
			    DENSE
			)

name: ERP Negativ Driver Andel %
expression: DIVIDE ( [ERP Negativ Kostnadsdriver], [ERP Total Negativ Kostnadsdriver] )

name: ERP Pareto Kumulativ Driver
expression:
VAR CurrentRank = [ERP Negativ Driver Rank]
			VAR DriverTable =
			    ADDCOLUMNS (
			        ALLSELECTED ( dim_account[account_name] ),
			        "@Rank", CALCULATE ( [ERP Negativ Driver Rank] ),
			        "@Driver", CALCULATE ( [ERP Negativ Kostnadsdriver] )
			    )
			RETURN
			    SUMX (
			        FILTER ( DriverTable, [@Rank] <= CurrentRank && NOT ISBLANK ( [@Driver] ) ),
			        [@Driver]
			    )

name: ERP Pareto Kumulativ %
expression: DIVIDE ( [ERP Pareto Kumulativ Driver], [ERP Total Negativ Kostnadsdriver] )

name: ERP Driver Tiltaksbehov Måned
expression: [ERP Månedlig Tiltaksbehov] * [ERP Negativ Driver Andel %]

name: ERP Driver Tiltaksbehov Restår
expression: [ERP Driver Tiltaksbehov Måned] * [ERP Måneder Igjen]

name: ERP Driver Tiltaksgrad %
expression: DIVIDE ( [ERP Driver Tiltaksbehov Restår], [ERP Negativ Kostnadsdriver] )

name: ERP Største Kostnadsdriver
expression:
VAR TopAccount =
			    TOPN (
			        1,
			        FILTER ( ALLSELECTED ( dim_account[account_name] ), CALCULATE ( [ERP Avvik YTD] ) < 0 ),
			        [ERP Negativ Kostnadsdriver], DESC,
			        dim_account[account_name], ASC
			    )
			RETURN CONCATENATEX ( TopAccount, dim_account[account_name], ", " )

name: ERP Største Kostnadsdriver Beløp
expression:
MAXX (
			    FILTER ( ALLSELECTED ( dim_account[account_name] ), CALCULATE ( [ERP Avvik YTD] ) < 0 ),
			    [ERP Negativ Kostnadsdriver]
			)

name: Selected Forecast Context
expression:
VAR YearTxt =
			    IF (
			        ISFILTERED ( dim_date[year] ),
			        CONCATENATEX ( VALUES ( dim_date[year] ), dim_date[year], ", ", dim_date[year], ASC ),
			        "Alle år"
			    )
			VAR OrganizationTxt =
			    IF (
			        ISFILTERED ( dim_budget_organization[budget_level_2_name] ),
			        CONCATENATEX (
			            VALUES ( dim_budget_organization[budget_level_2_name] ),
			            dim_budget_organization[budget_level_2_name],
			            ", ",
			            dim_budget_organization[budget_level_2_name],
			            ASC
			        ),
			        "Alle budsjettområder"
			    )
			RETURN "Viser: " & YearTxt & " | " & OrganizationTxt

name: ERP Forecast EOY RAG
expression:
VAR Gap = [ERP Forecast EOY Avvik]
			RETURN
			    SWITCH ( TRUE (), ISBLANK ( Gap ), "NO_DATA", Gap > 0, "GREEN", Gap < 0, "RED", "YELLOW" )

name: ERP Forecast EOY Color
expression: SWITCH ( [ERP Forecast EOY RAG], "GREEN", "#107C10", "YELLOW", "#FFB900", "RED", "#D13438", "#A19F9D" )

name: Forecast Action Summary
expression:
VAR Gap = [ERP Forecast EOY Avvik]
			VAR MonthlyAction = [ERP Månedlig Tiltaksbehov]
			VAR MonthlyActionPct = [ERP Månedlig Tiltaksbehov %]
			VAR RemainingMonths = [ERP Måneder Igjen]
			RETURN
			    SWITCH (
			        TRUE (),
			        ISBLANK ( Gap ), "Ingen prognose tilgjengelig.",
			        Gap >= 0, "Prognosen indikerer balanse eller mindreforbruk ved årets slutt. Ingen generell kostnadsreduksjon er nødvendig basert på dagens prognose.",
			        "Prognosen indikerer merforbruk ved årets slutt. For å nå budsjettbalanse må forventet månedlig kostnadsnivå reduseres med "
			            & FORMAT ( MonthlyAction, "#,##0 kr" )
			            & " per måned i de resterende " & FORMAT ( RemainingMonths, "0" )
			            & " månedene, tilsvarende " & FORMAT ( MonthlyActionPct, "0.0%" ) & "."
			    )
